sources.title: Video Understanding: From Geometry and Semantics to Unified Models
sources.snippet: Video understanding aims to enable models to perceive, reason about, and interact with the dynamic visual world. In contrast to image understanding, video understanding inherently requires modeling temporal dynamics and evolving visual context, placing stronger demands on spatiotemporal reasoning and making it a foundational problem in computer vision. sources.title: Video Understanding: From Geometry and Semantics to Unified Models | AI ...
sources.snippet: This survey organizes video understanding around three core pillars—low-level geometry recovery, high-level semantic reasoning, and unified models that combine both—establishing a conceptual framework for how the field has progressed from task-specific pipelines toward foundation models capable of handling diverse downstream objectives.
